items.title: Rename the 3 package.json names + cross-deps @lattice-agent -> @lattice
items.context: packages/main/package.json name @lattice-agent/core -> @lattice/core; packages/utils/package.json name @lattice-agent/utils -> @lattice/utils; packages/lab/package.json name @lattice-agent/lab -> @lattice/lab. Update every inter-package dependency entry (utils->@lattice/core, lab->@lattice/core, main->@lattice/lab). Then run a real `npm install` at the repo root so node_modules/@lattice/* workspace symlinks are created (do NOT symlink node_modules in this worktree). Keep the top-level package `name: lattice` and the `lattice` bin unchanged.

happy.desc: After rename, packages/main/package.json has name=@lattice/core, packages/utils/package.json has name=@lattice/utils, packages/lab/package.json has name=@lattice/lab -> verify with node -e reading all 3 package.json files; WHY: confirms the foundational name change landed in all 3 workspaces

Cross-deps updated: utils depends on @lattice/core, lab depends on @lattice/core, main depends on @lattice/lab -> parse each package.json dependencies block; WHY: workspace inter-package resolution depends on exact scope match

npm install at repo root succeeds and creates node_modules/@lattice/* workspace links (ls -la node_modules/@lattice/) -> links point to packages/{main,utils,lab}; WHY: npm workspace resolution must resolve @lattice/* not @lattice-agent/*
Top-level package.json name remains lattice (no scope) and bin entry remains lattice -> read root package.json; WHY: the CLI binary name must not change

edge.desc: node_modules/@lattice-agent/ directory should NOT exist after npm install (stale workspace links cleaned) -> ls node_modules/@lattice-agent/ should fail with ENOENT; WHY: leftover old-scope symlinks would allow stale imports to silently resolve
npm ls --depth=0 shows @lattice/core, @lattice/utils, @lattice/lab as workspace packages with no missing/invalid markers; WHY: npm workspace graph integrity after rename

adversarial.desc: Inject a require("@lattice-agent/core") in a test script after rename -> should fail with MODULE_NOT_FOUND; WHY: proves old scope is truly dead and cannot silently resolve via leftover symlinks or node_modules

Verify no package.json anywhere in the repo still contains @lattice-agent in name or dependency keys: git grep -n @lattice-agent -- **/package.json should return empty; WHY: catches partial rename (missed cross-dep or nested package.json)

items.title: Flip the 27 internal imports + self-host name constants to @lattice/core
items.context: Rewrite all `from '@lattice-agent/...'` / `require('@lattice-agent/...')` imports (27 in packages/**/src) to `@lattice/...`. Update self-host detection: CANONICAL_CORE_PACKAGE_NAME in runtime-environment-checks.ts, handlers/test-auto.ts, handlers/worktree.ts -> '@lattice/core'; rollout-check.ts `mainPackageName === '@lattice-agent/core'` -> '@lattice/core'; cli-init.ts dev-host import. Rebuild packages (utils then main then lab) tsc-clean; confirm `node bin/lattice.js --version` still resolves and runs under the new scope.

happy.desc: All 27 source imports rewritten: git grep -rn "from .@lattice-agent" -- packages/ returns 0 hits; git grep -rn "from .@lattice/" -- packages/ returns >= 27 hits -> WHY: confirms every import path flipped to new scope
CANONICAL_CORE_PACKAGE_NAME in runtime-environment-checks.ts equals @lattice/core -> grep the constant assignment; WHY: self-host detection key used at runtime to identify this repo

handlers/test-auto.ts and handlers/worktree.ts reference @lattice/core (not @lattice-agent/core) in their self-host detection -> grep both files; WHY: worktree creation and test-auto flows use this to find the workspace root
rollout-check.ts mainPackageName comparison uses @lattice/core -> grep isSelfLayout line; WHY: rollout check gates deploy readiness on correct self-host name

Full tsc --noEmit across all packages exits 0 (npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/utils && npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/main && npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/lab) -> WHY: type-checks that all rewritten imports resolve under the new scope
node bin/lattice.js --version runs successfully and prints a version string -> WHY: end-to-end self-host proof that the CLI loads under @lattice/core

edge.desc: cli-init.ts dev-host import path uses @lattice/core (not @lattice-agent/core) -> grep cli-init.ts for the import; WHY: cli-init is the entry point that bootstraps the dev-host path and is sensitive to scope mismatch
prompt-registry and runtime-fact-registry reference @lattice/core in their canonical name exports -> grep both files; WHY: these registries advertise the canonical package name to other subsystems
No require() calls reference @lattice-agent anywhere in packages/: git grep -rn "require.*@lattice-agent" -- packages/ returns 0; WHY: catches CJS-style refs that the from-import grep would miss

adversarial.desc: After rebuild, run node -e "require(\"@lattice/core\")" from repo root -> should resolve without error; WHY: proves the rebuilt dist is loadable under the new scope

Verify no .ts/.js file in packages/ contains a string literal @lattice-agent/core or @lattice-agent/utils or @lattice-agent/lab (excluding test fixtures that assert its absence): git grep -nE "@lattice-agent/(core|utils|lab)" -- packages/ should return 0 hits; WHY: adversarial sweep for partial rename in non-import contexts (comments, string constants, error messages)

items.title: Fix pre-push self-host check + retire legacy @koala-agent/core global fallback
items.context: .githooks/pre-push (lines ~24, ~148): change the self-host package-name check from @koala-agent/core to @lattice/core so the build+tsc gate runs for this repo (update done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md notes that flag this as pending). codex-adapter-checks.ts globalCoreCandidates: drop the @koala-agent/core entry (and per PLAN decision, optionally the @lattice-agent/core transitional entry), leaving @lattice/core; update worktree-repair-smoke.ts / flow-stability-smoke.ts legacy-fallback fixtures accordingly. Update verify-runtime-fact-contract.mjs / verify-entrypoints.mjs / verify-global-lab-entrypoint.mjs assertions to the @lattice/core canonical name. Keep verify-koala-residue.mjs as the residue checker but ensure it still passes and also guards the absence of a live @lattice-agent scope.

happy.desc: .githooks/pre-push line ~148 compares PKG_NAME to @lattice/core (not @koala-agent/core) -> grep pre-push for the comparison; WHY: the stale @koala-agent/core check causes the build+tsc gate to silently exit 0 (skip) in this repo

.githooks/pre-push comment block (line ~24) updated to reference @lattice/core -> grep pre-push for the comment; WHY: comment/code consistency prevents future confusion about which scope triggers the gate

codex-adapter-checks.ts globalCoreCandidates contains only @lattice/core entry (no @koala-agent/core, no @lattice-agent/core) -> grep codex-adapter-checks.ts for globalCoreCandidates array; WHY: legacy fallbacks must be retired, not left as dead paths

verify-koala-residue.mjs still passes (node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs exits 0) and also guards absence of live @lattice-agent scope -> WHY: the residue checker must be extended to catch the old-old AND old scope
verify-runtime-fact-contract.mjs assertions reference @lattice/core as canonical (not @lattice-agent/core) and still pass -> grep the file + run it; WHY: verifier must match the new canonical name

verify-entrypoints.mjs assertions reference @lattice/core, @lattice/utils, @lattice/lab package names and still pass -> grep the file + run it; WHY: entrypoint verifier validates workspace package names
verify-global-lab-entrypoint.mjs assertions reference @lattice/core and still pass -> grep the file + run it; WHY: global lab entrypoint verifier validates canonical core name

edge.desc: worktree-repair-smoke.ts and flow-stability-smoke.ts fixtures updated to remove @koala-agent/core legacy entries -> grep both smoke test files; WHY: test fixtures must reflect the retired fallback

verify-koala-residue.mjs regex pattern now catches both @koala-agent AND @lattice-agent live references -> inspect the regex patterns in the script; WHY: the residue checker scope must expand to cover the transitional name too

After removing @koala-agent/core from globalCoreCandidates, verify codex-adapter-checks does not throw when no global @koala-agent is installed -> the check should gracefully find no global core and continue; WHY: removing a fallback candidate must not introduce a crash on systems that never had the legacy global

items.title: Update hooks + docs to @lattice; run all self-host gates green
items.context: Update .codex/hooks + .claude/hooks, README.md, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG.md, and the couple of decision docs that name @lattice-agent as the current scope (NOT frozen .lattice/ history or docs/koala/ audits). Acceptance: `git grep -nE '@lattice-agent' -- . ':(exclude).lattice/**'` shows no LIVE current-scope reference (only intentional anti-residue assertions naming it as forbidden, if any, are justified); `git grep '@koala-agent/core'` shows only the residue-checker pattern + anti-residue assertions, no live fallback. Run green: full build + recursive tsc --noEmit, `lattice codex verify`, `lattice rollout check`, the koala-residue + runtime-fact + entrypoints verifiers, and confirm .githooks/pre-push now executes its build+tsc path under @lattice/core.

README.md, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG.md updated to @lattice where they previously said @lattice-agent -> git diff of these files shows the rename; WHY: user-facing docs must reflect the current scope

lattice rollout check exits 0; WHY: rollout readiness gate must pass under @lattice/core

adversarial.desc: git grep -nE @lattice-agent -- . :(exclude).lattice/** returns ONLY intentional anti-residue assertions (lines that assert @lattice-agent is forbidden/absent), zero LIVE references -> count and categorize every hit; WHY: the adversarial acceptance criterion from the story description, catches any missed rename

Run the full verifier suite: node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs && node scripts/verify-runtime-fact-contract.mjs && node scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs && node scripts/verify-global-lab-entrypoint.mjs -> all exit 0; WHY: verifiers are the automated acceptance gate and must all pass under the new scope
